fix.summary: A blind effect on an enemy cuts its senses for a short time. Blood-smoke blind 220010 makes fodder (SpEffect 241000/241010) drop its target at once; mini-bosses (241100) set a blind flag and later wait with a search clip before turning back. Firecracker blind 220011 and the smoke-ball blindness 200130 cut hearing and, for 200130, all sight angles.
fix.values: 220010 blood smoke blind (COMMON_SP_EFFECT_BLOOD_SMOKE), 220011 firecracker blind (0.5 s, hearingSearchEnemyCut 100), 220012-220016 related blinds (0.5 to 2 s, hearing cut 100), 200130 smoke-ball blindness (2 s, all four sight angle cuts and hearing 100), 107712 enemy-turn short blind (0.5 s, left angle cut 100). Reaction classes in NpcParam: 241000 fodder (960 rows), 241100 mini-boss (94), 241200 boss (102). Lua: table_ai_common ActivateSpecialEffect 220010 in FIND/BATTLE: fodder ClearEnemyTarget, 241100 sets AI_NUMBER_BLOOD_SMOKE_BLINDNESS = 1; _COMMON_AddBattleGoal then queues WaitWithAnime 400600 or 400610 (up to 30 s) and AttackTunableSpin 401040. While 220010 or 220011 is on, the caution approach goals skip MoveToSomewhere and run ConfirmCautionTarget instead. Per-enemy reaction cool-down rows exist for firecracker and ash (for example 251070/251071 Shura Samurai 15 s, 251080/251081 Seven-sided Warrior 30 s).
fix.how: The reaction SpEffect is applied by the item hit; the AI table handler reads it as an interrupt and either drops the target (fodder), starts the blind search sequence (mini-boss) or ignores it (boss).
fix.check: Throw a firecracker or smoke ball at a fodder soldier in FIND: it loses its target; do the same to a mini-boss (General) and see the 400600/400610 search clip.
